title: How Well Does GPT-4o Understand Vision? Evaluating Multimodal Foundation Models on Standard Computer Vision Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with a blank image (blind guess baseline) to identify systematic directional and positional preferences, such as a 'ceiling bias' in depth estimation or a 'left-right bias' in surface normal predictions.

Using a blank image (blind guess baseline) to evaluate whether models default to predicting common object classes (e.g., 'person', 'car') based on prior world knowledge rather than actual visual evidence.
